filling: Hey Isabella! I hope you're having a good day. Mind if I ask what you're working on today?

Oh, hey Maria! I'm having a lovely day, thank you for asking! Today, I'm busy getting ready for a little something special at Hobbs Cafe. We're having a Valentine's Day party for our customers on February 14th!
A Valentine's Day party? That sounds fun! What kind of special things are you guys planning for it?

We're putting together some lovely treats and creating a cozy, warm atmosphere for everyone to relax and enjoy themselves! I'm just finalizing some of the details right now. Are you planning on staying to check it out on the 14th?
Oh, I don't know yet! I'll have to see how my physics studies and streaming schedule look that week. It sounds like it's going to be a great event though!

Well, no pressure at all! Just wanted to spread the word! If you do decide to come, we'd absolutely love to have you. It's going to be a really cozy afternoon/evening. Do you need anything while you're studying today?
Nope, I'm all set for now, thanks! I just need to power through these thermodynamics problems before my study block gets too intense. But I'll definitely keep the Valentine's party in mind!
Sounds good! Well, keep up the great work with your studies, Maria. If you need a refill or anything at all while you're focusing, just let me know! Happy studying!
